verdict.rationale: Windmill documents an MCP server that lets LLM clients trigger scripts/flows via natural-language chat (windmill-docs-17, windmill-probe-4) and an AI-generation feature where a user can ask the AI to edit and review flow/script changes (windmill-docs-21), showing real natural-language operability. However, evidence is thin—just two doc snippets—with no independent/hands-on corroboration of reliability or scope of NL commands. Missing for 10: hands-on/community validation of NL-driven operation, fuller documentation of what natural-language commands can accomplish beyond triggering and editing.
